source.title: Some open problems in the theory of biorthogonal polynomials

trace.notes: Input normalized as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/2209687. Local workflow shard metadata matches the same zbMATH resolver record and identifies the source as 'Some open problems in the theory of biorthogonal polynomials' (2002). A bounded exact-title search found the SSFA proceedings table of contents for the Third Annual Conference of the Society for Special Functions and their Applications, Varanasi, March 4-6, 2002, listing 'Some Open Problems in the Theory of Biorthogonal Polynomials' by A.K. Agarwal, but not the article text.

Access failure mode: network_or_dns_failure plus blocked_or_challenged. Shell fetching could not resolve api.zbmath.org in the restricted environment. Browser access to the zbMATH page, REST API, and OAI-PMH routes did not expose a readable primary artifact and showed API/OAI terms gates rather than record full text.

Bounded exact-work recovery used the zbMATH identifier, exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus author, and proceedings-title searches. Recovered candidates were metadata-only or citation-only pages, including the SSFA table of contents and ResearchGate reference lists in related biorthogonal-polynomial papers, or different works. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered.

No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML artifact was available. The source-adequacy gate forbids extracting questions from zbMATH metadata, local shard metadata, proceedings contents, citation pages, search snippets, references in other papers, or related works.
No candidates were accepted because there were no verbatim problem-statement quotes with page numbers or stable HTML locators from a readable primary source.
